[RDSC.5a.7d.1] The `SeriesBackendMonotonicDeque` atom declares a monotonic deque providing
**exact** sliding-window `min` / `max`. The deque holds the monotonic
subsequence of in-window candidates, so a query reads the front in O(1)
and amortised insert/evict is O(1); worst-case state is O(window·rate).
